As of the [[2020 United States census]], the borough's population was 4,454, an increase of 228 (+5.4%) from the [[2010 United States census|2010 census]] count of 4,226, which in turn reflected an increase of 73 (+1.8%) from the 4,153 counted in the [[2000 United States census|2000 census]].[https://www.nj.gov/labor/labormarketinformation/assets/PDFs/census/2010/2010data/table7cm.xls Table 7.
